assigned-groups.h: WHAT HAPPENS IN THE UPDATE STEP
assigned-groups.t: In the **update step** the memberships from the assignment step are **frozen**. The old centers (diamonds) are still at their starting positions.

select-cluster.t: Take the middle cluster (gold): the customers **(6, 6), (6.5, 5.5) and (7, 6.2)**. The other clusters are dimmed for now.

collect-x.t: Read off the purchases per month of the three members: **6, 6.5 and 7**.

collect-y.t: Read off their average spend, the vertical coordinate: **6, 5.5 and 6.2**. The x and y values are averaged separately.

average-x.t: **Mean x = (6 + 6.5 + 7) / 3 = 6.5.** The vertical line marks it.

average-y.t: **Mean y = (6 + 5.5 + 6.2) / 3 = 5.9.** The horizontal line marks it.

new-centroid.t: The new centroid is **(6.5, 5.9)**, the coordinate-wise mean. It need not be one of the data points.

move-centroid.t: The center moves from **(5, 3) to (6.5, 5.9)**. The three customers do not move; **only the center does**.

update-all.t: Every cluster does the same: the centers move to **(1.68, 2.0), (6.5, 5.9) and (4.3, 7.98)**. Memberships are still the old ones, so the next assignment may change them.
